start.title: [TODO:ru] The Plain of Shinar
start.text:
[TODO:ru] A wide green plain stretches ahead.
All mankind has gathered here — one people, one tongue.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Settle and build a home
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You sink roots into the earth. It feels right.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Dream of something greater
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The horizon is not enough. You want the sky.

unity.title: [TODO:ru] One Tongue
unity.text:
[TODO:ru] Voices blend. Laughter rises.
There is no word you cannot understand.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Praise God for the gift of unity
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You lift your voice in thanks. Others bow their heads.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Boast of what we could achieve
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Pride sparks in the crowd. Eyes turn upward.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stay silent — listen to the elders
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Wise voices speak softly. Others shout louder.

proposal.title: [TODO:ru] The Great Idea
proposal.text:
[TODO:ru] An elder rises. "Let us build a tower — its top in the heavens."
"Let us make a name for ourselves."

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Cheer — join the great work
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your voice is one of thousands. The crowd roars.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Speak against it — this is pride
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Few hear you. But the words are spoken.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Wait — let others decide
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Silence is its own answer. The vote passes.

bricks.title: [TODO:ru] Bricks and Tar
bricks.text:
[TODO:ru] You mold wet clay into bricks.
They are stronger than stone. They will reach the sky.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Work for the love of craft
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your hands move with care. The work itself is good.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Race the others — outshine them
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your speed turns to recklessness. Bricks crack.

construction.title: [TODO:ru] The First Floors
construction.text:
[TODO:ru] Walls rise. The tower casts a long shadow.
Men sing as they lift each beam.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Boast — "We need no God now"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Workers cheer. Above, the silence deepens.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Work quietly — say a prayer
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] No one hears. But the prayer is heard above.

rising.title: [TODO:ru] Higher
rising.text:
[TODO:ru] Year after year. Stone upon stone.
The tower pierces the clouds.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Doubt — should we stop?
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You whisper it. The wind carries the words away.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Climb higher — there is no limit
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The ladder feels endless. Your pride is fuel.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Demand the workers go faster
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Tempers fray. Hands bleed. The tower climbs.

summit.title: [TODO:ru] Touching the Sky
summit.text:
[TODO:ru] You stand at the top. The earth is small below.
The heavens feel close — almost within reach.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Reach upward — claim the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your fingers find only wind. Yet you feel watched.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Kneel — feel suddenly small
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The vastness above swallows your pride.

gods_gaze.title: Он спускается
gods_gaze.text:
Голос наполняет воздух, спокойный, как гром.
«Они — один народ. Ничто не будет для них невозможным».

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stand defiant before the voice
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your courage withers. The air grows heavy.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Bow your head in fear and awe
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your knees buckle. The presence is everywhere.

confusion.title: Странные слова
confusion.text:
Ты кричишь другу. Он смотрит.
Его рот открывается — но звуки не имеют смысла.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Force him to understand — shout louder
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Anger only deepens the void between you.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Step back — accept what God has done
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Tears fall. The wall between you is unbreakable.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Blame the elders — start a fight
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Fists fly. The tower bleeds men instead of mortar.

scattering.title: Уход
scattering.text:
Семьи собирают, что могут.
Каждая группа идёт к разному горизонту.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Curse the heavens as you leave
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Bitterness is a heavy load to carry.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Walk in silence, lesson in heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Each step is a small confession.

reflection.title: Новая земля
reflection.text:
Ты останавливаешься на тихом хребте.
Башня далеко позади — воспоминание о гордости.
